description: Add an explicit RollingUpdate strategy whose maxUnavailable leaves at least one pod serving traffic during a rollout
prompts: k8s/deployment.yaml's notifications-api Deployment (replicas: 2) has no explicit update strategy, so it falls back to Kubernetes' default RollingUpdate (25% maxUnavailable/25% maxSurge), which on 2 replicas rounds down to maxUnavailable: 0 already - but that's an accident of the default math, not a deliberate choice, and it silently breaks the moment someone bumps replicas. Add an EXPLICIT spec.strategy: type RollingUpdate with maxUnavailable: 1 and maxSurge: 1, so the intent (never more than one pod down at a time during a rollout, and headroom for one extra pod while rolling) survives future replica-count changes.

setup_files.k8s/deployment.yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: notifications-api
  namespace: default
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: notifications-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: notifications-api
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: notifications-api
          image: ghcr.io/example/notifications-api:1.0.0

test_setup_files.check_strategy.py:
import yaml

with open("k8s/deployment.yaml") as f:
    dep = yaml.safe_load(f)

strategy = dep["spec"].get("strategy") or {}
assert strategy.get("type") == "RollingUpdate", f"expected RollingUpdate, got {strategy.get('type')}"

ru = strategy.get("rollingUpdate") or {}
assert ru.get("maxUnavailable") == 1, f"expected maxUnavailable 1, got {ru.get('maxUnavailable')}"
assert ru.get("maxSurge") == 1, f"expected maxSurge 1, got {ru.get('maxSurge')}"

assert dep["spec"]["replicas"] == 2, "replicas must stay unchanged"

print("PASS rolling update strategy checks")

reference_solution.k8s/deployment.yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: notifications-api
  namespace: default
spec:
  replicas: 2
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxUnavailable: 1
      maxSurge: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: notifications-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: notifications-api
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: notifications-api
          image: ghcr.io/example/notifications-api:1.0.0
